question: Which energy-calibration ambiguities of the existing four-sector source are determined by its native disorder operator, and which remain invisible?
summary_de: Im vorhandenen bedingten v1033-Fock-Lift lässt die sektorinterne CAR-Dynamik vier Energieoffsets unbestimmt. Der originale Disorder-Operator D verbindet die vier C-Sektoren: seine sektoraufgelöste Zeitantwort bestimmt drei relative Offsets eindeutig; der gemeinsame Offset bleibt unsichtbar. Vier D-übersetzte Präparationen liefern ein konkretes Antwortprotokoll. D² allein lässt zusätzlich den geraden/ungeraden Unterschied offen. Keine P1/P2-, absolute Quellen- oder Gravitationseinordnung hergeleitet.
summary_en: In the existing conditional v1033 Fock lift, sector-internal CAR dynamics leaves four energy offsets undetermined. The original disorder D connects all four C sectors: its sector-resolved time response fixes three relative offsets, with one common offset invisible. Four D-translated preparations provide a concrete response protocol. D squared alone also leaves the even/odd difference undetermined. No P1/P2, absolute source or gravitational normalization is derived.
assumptions: Existing conditional C4 tensor Fock(V) lift and completed charged CAR dictionary; not selected by P1/P2.
Same Hamiltonian action on full completed CAR algebra and C, with common time convention.
Native D and all four sectors retained; complex time response or its first derivative is available.
Known native H baseline response is subtracted from the shifted response; the response of an unspecified source alone does not identify its offsets.
Constructive protocol additionally permits fixed D^k-translated preparations; no replacement ground is selected after shifting H.
Fixed background; no inference that sectors are geometries, families or spacetime dimensions.
positive_results: The ambiguity preserving the specified internal Heisenberg action is exactly sum_s c_s P_s.
Native D response fixes c_(s+1)-c_s; C4 incidence rank3 leaves only one common scalar.
D squared alone has rank2; full native D removes the additional parity-component ambiguity.
The original finite 256-dimensional source and its unique ground reproduce the four-response reconstruction.
kills: Treat four independent sector energy shifts as invisible after retaining the full original D response.
Replace native D by D squared while claiming unchanged calibration information.
Infer absolute geometric normalization from relative sector calibration.
leaves_open: P1/P2 selection of the conditional parent, observable algebra and preparation menu.
Physical measurement and time dictionary for native D insertions.
One common energy shift at each background and the source-dependent geometric functional Q[g].
Joint local physical source, metric/continuum dynamics and T1–T8 completion.
novelty_scope: Project-specific synthesis and constructive calibration inverse using standard finite-dimensional operator algebra, not a new general theorem or source-derived physical model.
original_source_scope_correction: Algebraic invisibility of c(g)I does not show admissibility of arbitrary c(g) or lambdaQ[g] in the specified original profile-free zeta/residue functional. Its actual off-shell source family must be derived and compared.
scope: Existing conditional v1033 C4 tensor Fock lift, full completed CAR+C action, native D and known baseline response at fixed background; relative energy calibration only, no P1/P2 selection or physical/gravity closure.
